title: MM6 Land Dragon
description: Original MM6 land dragon A: wingless quadruped with dark forest-green mottled scales, long slender curved neck, narrow crocodilian horned head, muscular but slender four legs, arched elongated torso and long tapering tail. Numerous thin golden-yellow spines run from head down neck/back/tail, gold segmented throat and underside, very pale ivory-blue tips on the longest head horns and claws, yellow-green eyes. Preserve exact native spiny silhouette, four-legged stance, small head, long neck, tail and foot placement, fine scale mottling and dark tonal weight. No wings, extra limbs, armor, ornaments or redesign.
regions: Native hide, underside, horns and wing material; selective enhanced-art masks derived after palette review.
